ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 1) Who is the poet of Skylark and Winds?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Shelley is known as Revolutionary Poet, Lyrical Poet, Poet of Wind and Poet of Hope and Regeneration. He was expelled from Oxford University for atheism. He was drowned while he was crossing the Adriatic Sea in 1822.
Famous works of Shelley:
Prometheus Unbound, Adonais, A Defence of Poetry, Ode to the West Wind, To a Skylark, Alaster, Ozymandias, Queen Mab, The Cloud etc.
[Source: Live MCQ Lecture]

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 2) Who is not a Victorian poet?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Samuel Beckett, in full Samuel Barclay Beckett, (born April 13, 1906, Foxrock, County Dublin, Ireland—died December 22, 1989, Paris, France), 20th century Irish novelist, author, critic, and playwright, winner of the Nobel Prize for Literature in 1969. He wrote in both French and English and is perhaps best known for his plays, especially En attendant Godot (1952; Waiting for Godot).
His notable works: The Unnamable, Molloy, Watt, Endgame, Malone Dies, Murphy, Krapp’s Last Tape, Dream of Fair to Middling Women, Whoroscope etc.
[Source: Live MCQ Lecture and Encyclopaedia Britannica ]

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 3) The earliest epic ‘Beowulf’ is written in -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Beowulf, heroic poem, the highest achievement of Old English literature(England) and the earliest European vernacular epic. It is also the first monument in English literature.
[Source: Encyclopaedia Britannica and An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman]

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 4) Who is the author of ‘The House of Fame’?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
The House of Fame, a poem of more than 2,000 lines, also in dream-vision form. It is written by Geoffrey Chaucer.
His other famous poetry: The Book of the Duchess, The Legend of Good Women, The Parliament of Fowls, The Canterbury Tales etc.
[ Source: Encyclopaedia Britannica]

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 5) The Renaissance period ends at-
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
The Renaissance period starts from 1500 AD and ends at 1660 AD.
The Renaissance Period (1500-1660) is divided into four main periods.
1. Elizabethan Period (1558-1603),
2. Jacobean Period (1603-1625),
3. Caroline Period (1625-1649) and
4. Commonwealth Period (1649-1660).
[Source: Live MCQ Lecture]

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 6) Machiavellian Character means -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
In literature, Machiavellian character means 'selfish character'.
Source: Encyclopaedia Britannica.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 7) Edmund Spenser is a poet of -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Elizabethan literature, body of works written during the reign of Elizabeth I of England (1558–1603), probably the most splendid age in the history of English literature, during which such writers as Sir Philip Sidney, Edmund Spenser, Roger Ascham, Richard Hooker, Christopher Marlowe, and William Shakespeare flourished.
[source: britanica]

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 8) Which period is known as the Golden period of English Literature?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
The Elizabethan period is known as The Golden/Glorious period of English Literature/Drama. Also called A nest of singing birds. This period is a period of original romanticism. The Elizabethan period was replete with Songs and lyrics.
[Source: Live MCQ Lecture ]

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 9) Who is the author of the drama ‘You never can tell’?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
The drama ‘You Never Can Tell’ is written by George Bernard Shaw.
George Bernard Shaw, (born July 26, 1856, Dublin, Ireland—died November 2, 1950, Ayot St. Lawrence, Hertfordshire, England), Irish comic dramatist, literary critic, and socialist propagandist, winner of the Nobel Prize for Literature in 1925.
His other notable works: Pygmalion, Mrs. Warren’s Profession, Arms and the Man, Saint Joan, Heartbreak House, Major Barbara, Caesar and Cleopatra, Man and Superman, The Doctor’s Dilemma, Androcles and the Lion etc.
[ Source: Encyclopaedia Britannica]

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 10) Who wrote ‘Utopia’?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
The word first occurred in Sir Thomas More’s Utopia, published in Latin as Libellus…de optimo reipublicae statu, deque nova insula Utopia (1516; “Concerning the highest state of the republic and the new island Utopia”); it was compounded by More from the Greek words for “not” (ou) and “place” (topos) and thus meant “nowhere.”
[ Source: Encyclopaedia Britannica]

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 11) Who is the father of English sonnet?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
The father of the English sonnet is Sir Thomas Wyatt(1503-1542).He introduced the Italian sonnet and Theresa Reimer verse form and the French Rondou into English literature.
[Source: Encyclopaedia Britannica]

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 12) ‘The Faerie Queene’ is written by -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Edmund Spenser, (born 1552/53, London, England—died January 13, 1599, London), English poet whose long allegorical poem ‘The Faerie Queene’ is one of the greatest in the English language. It was written in what came to be called the Spenserian stanza.
[Source: Encyclopaedia Britannica]

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 13) Which one is called the embryo of English Literature?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Sir Philip Sidney is a famous critic and was also a poet and soldier. In 1580 he had completed a version of his heroic prose romance, the Arcadia. It is a book that bears the embryo of English Novel.
His other famous books are: The Lady of May, An Apology for Poetry.
[Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Encyclopaedia Britannica]

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 14) Who is the Author of the book ‘Blood Of Vintage’?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
“Blood Of Vintage” is written by Thomas Kyd. He is the Father of English Revenge Tragedy.
His famous play: The Spanish Tragedy. It is called Bloody Drama.
[Source: An ABC of English Literature - Dr M Mofizar Rahman and Britannica]

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 15) ‘Odyssey’ is translated into English by -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
George Chapman translated Homer’s “Illiad” and “Odyssey” into English. The first books of his translation of the Iliad appeared in 1598. It was completed in 1611, and his version of the Odyssey appeared in 1616. Chapman’s Homer contains passages of great power and beauty and inspired the sonnet of John Keats “On First Looking into Chapman’s Homer” (1815).
[Source: Encyclopaedia Britannica]

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 16) Francis Bacon is a/an-
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Francis Bacon(1561-1626), lord chancellor of England (1618–21). A lawyer, statesman, natural philosopher, and master of the English tongue, he is remembered in literary terms for the sharp worldly wisdom of a few dozen essays. He is called the father of Modern Essay in English Literature.
His other notable works: De Sapientia Veterum, Instauratio Magna,The New Atlantis, Novum Organum, Advancement of Learning, Commentarius Solutus etc.
[Source: Encyclopaedia Britannica and Live MCQ Lecture]

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 17) Who is known as the father of English Tragedy?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Christopher Marlowe (1564 - 93) is called:
- A University Wit.
- Greatest Dramatist before Shakespeare.
- Father of English Tragedy.
[Source: Live MCQ Lecture]

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 18) Who is not a University Wits?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
University wits are a group of young dramatists who wrote and performed in London towards the end of the 16th century during the Elizabethan Period.
Thomas Kyd, John Lyly, Robert Greene, George Peele, Christopher Marlowe and Thomas Nashe are university wits.
[source: An ABC of English Literature - Dr M Mofizar Rahman]

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 19) Shakespeare was born in -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
William Shakespeare is the greatest English dramatist. He is famous for the objective presentation of his deep knowledge about human psychology.
He was born on 23 April, 1564 AD and died on 23 April, 1616 AD. His Birthplace is Stratford Avon.
'1590-1616' is called the Shakespearean period.
He is often called The Bard of Avon.
He wrote 37 plays and 154 sonnets.
[Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture]

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 20) Which one is the last play by Shakespeare?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
William Shakespeare is the greatest English dramatist. He is mostly known for his plays. His last work is The Tempest.
His famous comedies are As You Like It, The Comedy of Errors, Twelfth Night, The Taming of The Shrew, Mid Summer Night's Dream, The Tempest, The Two Gentleman of Verona, The Merry Wives of Windsor, The Winter's Tale, Cymbeline, Pericles, Prince of Tyre, The Two Nobel Kinsman, Much Ado About Nothing, Love's Labours Lost.
His famous Tragedies are Hamlet, Macbeth, Othello, King Lear, Julius Caesar, Romeo and Juliet, Antony and Cleopatra, Titus Andronicus, Timon of Athens.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 21) ‘Cowards die many times before their death’ is an important quotation from -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Julius Caesar is a Tragedy of William Shakespeare.
Important quotation of this Tragedy:
'Veni, Vidi, Vici (I came, I saw, I conquered)',
'Cowards die many times before their death',
'Brutus, you too!'.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 22) Othello gave Desdemona a __ as a token of love.
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Othello, in full Othello, the Moor of Venice, tragedy in five acts by William Shakespeare, written in 1603–04 and published in 1622 in a quarto edition from a transcript of an authorial manuscript.
Making use of a handkerchief belonging to Desdemona and found by Emilia when Othello has unwittingly dropped it, Iago persuades Othello that Desdemona has given the handkerchief to Cassio as a love token. Iago also induces Othello to eavesdrop on a conversation between himself and Cassio that is in fact about Cassio’s mistress, Bianca, but which Othello is led to believe concerns Cassio’s infatuation with Desdemona. Overcome with jealousy, Othello kills Desdemona. When he learns from Emilia, too late, that his wife is blameless, he asks to be remembered as one who “loved not wisely but too well” and kills himself.
[Source: Encyclopaedia Britannica]

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 23) ‘Much Ado About Nothing’ is written by -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Much Ado About Nothing, comedy in five acts by William Shakespeare, written probably in 1598–99 and printed in a quarto edition from the author’s own manuscript in 1600. The play takes an ancient theme—that of a woman falsely accused of unfaithfulness—to brilliant comedic heights. Shakespeare used as his main source for the Claudio-Hero plot a story from Matteo Bandello’s Novelle (1554–73); he also may have consulted Ludovico Ariosto’s Orlando furioso and Edmund Spenser’s The Faerie Queene.
[Source: Encyclopaedia Britannica]

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 24) ‘Silent Woman’ is written by -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Ben Jonson Comedies are known as 'Comedy of Humors'.
His famous writings are The Magnetic Lady, Volpone, Every Man Out of His Humour, Every Man in His Humour, The Silent Woman, The Alchemist, The Devil is an Ass etc.
[Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture]

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 25) ‘The Good-Morrow’ is a poem, written by -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
John Donne is The Father of Metaphysical Poets. He is called the Poet of Love and Religious Poet.
His famous poems are: The Good Morrow, The Sun Rising, The Canonization, Twicknam Garden, For Whom The Bell Tolls, The Anatomy of the World (book), The Frea, The Ecstasy, The Funeral etc.
[Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture]

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 26) The poem ‘Cherry Ripe’ is written by -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
The English cleric and “Cavalier Poet” Robert Herrick is especially remembered for his ‘Hesperides’ of 1648. Named after the mythological garden of golden apples, this collection of lyrics contains the well-known poem ‘Cherry Ripe’. His verse touched on a wide range of subjects from satire, love and erotic fantasy to pastoral themes and politics. His earlier work, ‘Noble Numbers’, contains some 1400 short, melodious poems on religious themes.
[Source: timewisetraveller.co.uk]

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 27) “Help Thyself, Good will help you” - is said by
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
George Herbert, (born April 3, 1593, Montgomery Castle, Wales—died March 1, 1633, Bemerton, Wiltshire, Eng.), English religious poet, a major metaphysical poet, notable for the purity and effectiveness of his choice of words. His famous quote is “Help Thyself, Good will help you”.
[Source: Encyclopaedia Britannica]

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 28) Who wrote ‘On His Blindness’?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
John Milton is a writer of Caroline Age. He is called Epic Poet and also called 'A great master of verse in Puritan Period'.
His famous Epics are Paradise Lost and Paradise Regained and his famous books are Comus, Lycidas, Of Education and Areopagitica.
John Milton's poem, ''On His Blindness,'' is an example of a Petrarchan sonnet.
[Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Encyclopedia.com]

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 29) Of the following authors who wrote an epic?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
John Milton is a writer of Caroline Age. He is called Epic Poet and also called 'A great master of verse in Puritan Period'.
His famous Epics are Paradise Lost and Paradise Regained.
[Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture]

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 30) Which one is a comedy?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
John Dryden is known as the father of modern criticism.
‘An Evening’s love’ is a comedy by Dryden produced 1668, published 1671.
‘Mac Flecknoe’ is an extended verse satire by John Dryden, written in the mid-1670s.
His tragedy ‘All for Love’ (1677), based on Shakespeare's Antony and Cleopatra and written in a flowing but controlled blank verse.
Dryden collaborated with Purcell in a dramatic opera, ‘King Arthur’ (1691), which also succeeded.
[Source: Live MCQ Lecture and Encyclopaedia Britannica]

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 31) ‘The Mourning Bride’ is written by -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
William Congreve was famous for Comedy of Manners.
His famous plays:
The Mourning Bride, The Way of The World, Love for Love, The Double Dealer, The Old Bachelor etc.
[Source: Live MCQ lecture]

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 32) First English Daily from London ‘The Daily Courant’ was published in -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
One of the first daily newspapers, The Daily Courant, appeared in 1702. It was a single sheet of newsprint introduced by Edward and Elizabeth Mallett. The first English newspaper, the Weekly News, was published in 1622. The first regularly published newspapers appeared in German cities and in Antwerp about 1609.
[Source: Encyclopaedia Britannica and theguardian.com]

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 33) ‘Poetry is the spontaneous overflow of powerful feelings’ - said by
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
William Wordsworth is a famous Romantic poet.
Famous quotes of Wordsworth:
'Child is the father of man',
'Our birth is but a sleep and a forgetting',
'Nature never did betray the heart that loved her',
'Poetry is a spontaneous overflow of powerful feelings',
'Poet is the breath and final speed of knowledge',
'Come forth into the light of things, let nature be your teacher'.
[Source: Live MCQ lecture]

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 34) Who was the famous mock-heroic poet in English literature?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Alexander Pope was a famous mock-heroic poet in English literature.
Famous epics of Alexander Pope is- The Rape of the Lock.
His famous works are: An Essay on Criticism, The Dunciad, The Imitation of Horace, An Essay on Man, Letter to Gay.
[Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture]

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 35) Who wrote the novel 'Robinson Crusoe'?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
‘Robinson Crusoe’, novel by Daniel Defoe, first published in London in 1719. Defoe’s first long work of fiction, it introduced two of the most-enduring characters in English literature: Robinson Crusoe and Friday.
[Source: Encyclopaedia Britannica]

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 36) ‘The Battle of the Books’ is written by -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Jonathan Swift is the greatest satirist of the 18th century.
His famous novels are Gulliver's Travels, A tale of a Tub, A Modest Proposal, A Journey to Stella, The Battle of the Books.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ lecture.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 37) The pen name of ‘Henry Fielding’ is -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Henry Fielding is regarded as the 'Father of Modern English Novel'.
He is famous for Picaresque Novels.
His pen name is Captain Hercules Vinegar.
His famous plays are: Rape Upon Rape, The Temple Beau, The Tragedy of Tragedies, The Modern Husband and his famous Novels are Tom Jones, Amelia, Joseph Andrews.
[Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture]

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 38) Who is considered a founder of the English novel?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Henry Fielding(April 22, 1707-Oct. 8, 1754), novelist and playwright, who, with Samuel Richardson, is considered a founder of the English novel.
Among his major novels are Joseph Andrews (1742) and Tom Jones (1749).
[Source: Encyclopaedia Britannica]

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 39) Who wrote the first English Dictionary?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
‘A Dictionary of the English Language’ was first published on 15 April 1755 by Samuel Johnson.
Other famous literary works: A Preface to Shakespeare, The Lives of Poets, Irene.
[Source: Encyclopaedia Britannica]

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 40) Who wrote ‘Elegy written in a country churchyard’?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Thomas Gray(1716-1771), English poet whose “An Elegy Written in a Country Churchyard” is one of the best known of English lyric poems. Although his literary output was slight, he was the dominant poetic figure in the mid-18th century and a precursor of the Romantic movement.
[Source: Encyclopaedia Britannica]

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 41) Who is not a poet of the Romantic Age?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Jane Austen, William Blake, Charles Lamb, Lord Byron, William Hazlitt, William Wordsworth S.T. Coleridge, John Keats, PB Shelley etc. are poets of the Romantic Age. Maxim Gorky is a poet of the Modern Age.
[Source: Live MCQ lecture]

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 42) ‘Lyrical Ballads’ was published in the year of-
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Lyrical Ballads, collection of poems, first published in 1798 by Samuel Taylor Coleridge and William Wordsworth, the appearance of which is often designated by scholars as a signal of the beginning of English Romanticism.
The work included Coleridge’s “Rime of the Ancient Mariner” and Wordsworth’s “Tintern Abbey,” as well as many controversial common-language poems by Wordsworth, such as “The Idiot Boy.”
[Source: Encyclopaedia Britannica]

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 43) ‘William Wordsworth’ wrote -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.option1: ক) The Rape of the Lock
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
William Wordsworth is an English poet whose ‘Lyrical Ballads’ (1798), written with Samuel Taylor Coleridge, helped launch the English Romantic movement.
Famous poems of Wordsworth: The Solitary Reaper, Tintern Abbey, Rainbow, Lucy Poems, The Daffodils, Ode on immortality, The Excursion, Michael etc.
‘The Rape of the Lock’ is a mock-heroic narrative poem written by Alexander Pope.
‘The Collar’ is a poem by Welsh poet George Herbert.
‘Persuasion’, novel by Jane Austen, published posthumously in 1817.
[Source: Encyclopaedia Britannica]

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 44) ‘The Rime of the ancient Mariner’ is a -

Dan Brown, (born June 22, 1964, Exeter, New Hampshire, U.S.), American author who wrote well-researched novels that centred on secret organizations and had intricate plots. He was best known for the Robert Langdon series, which notably included The Da Vinci Code (2003).
[source: britannica]

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 86) Pearl S. Buck awarded Nobel Prize for the book -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Pearl S. Buck is an American novelist and writer. She was awarded the Nobel prize in 1938 for her rich and truly epic description of peasant life in China. Pearl S. Buck was the first American woman to win the Nobel prize for literature.
Source: Live MCQ lecture.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 87) Who wrote Prometheus Bound?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Prometheus Bound, Greek Promētheus desmōtēs, tragedy by Aeschylus, the dating of which is uncertain. The play concerns the god Prometheus, who in defiance of Zeus (Jupiter) has saved humanity with his gift of fire.
[Source: Encyclopaedia Britannica]

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 88) A ‘Canto’ is a/an
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Canto, major division of an epic or other long narrative poem. An Italian term, derived from the Latin cantus (“song”), it probably originally indicated a portion of a poem that could be sung or chanted by a minstrel at one sitting.
[source: britannica]

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 89) A serious play with a sad ending is called a -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Tragedy, branch of drama that treats in a serious and dignified style the sorrowful or terrible events encountered or caused by a heroic individual.
[source: britannica]
Tragedy: a play about death or suffering with a sad end, or this type of play generally.
[source: dictionary.cambridge.org]

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 90) A person who writhes about his own life writes
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Autobiography- the biography of oneself narrated by oneself;A person who writes about his own life writes.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 91) Samuel Beckett is the author of -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Murphy, novel by Irish writer Samuel Beckett, published in 1938.
The story concerns an Irishman in London who yearns to do nothing more than sit in his rocking chair and daydream.
source: britannica

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: ৯২) “You may fool some of the people some of the time, you can even fool some of the people all the time; but you can’t fool all the people all time” - said by:
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
প্রশ্নোক্ত উক্তিটি কে করেছেন, তা নিয়ে যথেষ্ট বিতর্ক আছে। তবে তা আব্রাহাম লিংকনের উক্তি হিসেবেই বেশি প্রচলিত। ১৮৫৬ সালে রাজনৈতিক সভায় কিংবা ১৮৫৮ সালে প্রেসিডেন্সিয়াল বিতর্কে তিনি এই উক্তি করেন। তবে এই সব তথ্যের পক্ষে শক্ত কোন প্রমাণ নেই।

যাইহোক প্রচলিত তথ্যের ভিত্তিতে আমরা আব্রাহাম লিংকনকে এই উক্তির বক্তা হিসেবে ধরে নিচ্ছি। উক্তি টি বিভিন্ন উৎসে বিভিন্ন ভাবে পাওয়া গেছে। যেমন-
You can fool all the people some of the time and some of the people all the time, but you cannot fool all the people all the time.
Or, You can fool some of the people all of the time, and all of the people some of the time, but you can not fool all of the people all of the time.
Or, You can fool all the people part of the time, or you can fool some people all the time, but you cannot fool all people all the time.

উৎস: বিভিন্ন নির্ভরযোগ্য আন্তর্জাতিক পত্র-পত্রিকা এবং স্কলারদের আর্টিক্যাল।

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 93) ‘The Dark Room’ is written by -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
R.K. Narayan, in full Rasipuram Krishnaswami Narayan, original name Rasipuram Krishnaswami Narayanswami, (born October 10, 1906, Madras [Chennai], India—died May 13, 2001, Madras), one of the finest Indian authors of his generation writing in English.
His famous works:
Novel - Swami and Friends, The Bachelor of Arts, The Dark Room, Waiting for the Mahatma, The Man-Eater of Malgudi etc.
Short story - Malgudi Days, A Horse and Two Goats, Under the Banyan Tree and Other stories, Lawley Roads and Other Stories etc.
Source: Brittanica.com

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 94) ‘Heard melodies are sweet but those unheard are __.’
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Famous quotes of Keats:
- Beauty is truth, truth beauty.
- A thing of beauty is a joy forever.
- Heard melodies are sweet but those unheard are sweeter.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 95) 'Brutus' is a famous character created by -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Julius Caesar is a famous Tragedy of William Shakespeare. Julius Caesar was a ruler of Rome about 2000 years ago.
Main characters of Julius Caesar are Antony, Caesar, Brutus etc.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 96) ‘September on Jessore Road’ is written by -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
September on Jessore Road is a poem by Allen Ginsberg on refugees from Bangladesh Liberation war in 1971. During Bangladesh's Liberation War in 1971, the US government was an ally of Pakistan and even sent its 7th fleet to intimidate India from interfering with the events in then East Pakistan.
source: The New York Times.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 97) Who is the author of the novel ‘roots’?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Alex Haley, in full Alexander Palmer Haley, (born August 11, 1921, Ithaca, New York, U.S.—died February 10, 1992, Seattle, Washington), American writer whose works of historical fiction and reportage depicted the struggles of African Americans.
Haley’s greatest success was Roots: The Saga of an American Family (1976). This saga covers seven American generations, from the enslavement of Haley’s African ancestors to his own genealogical quest. The work forcefully shows relationships between generations and between races.
source: britannica

“Books, the children of the brain” is a quotation from ‘A Tale of Tub’ by Jonathan swift.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 99) Allegorical means -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp: A Story or picture with two or more different meanings- a literal meaning and one or more symbolic meanings. The setting, characters, and things that happen inside an allegory are symbols for ideas and qualities. Allegory অর্থ হচ্ছে অন্য কিছু বোঝানো।
